titleEn: When I Sat Down to Look

pages.text: Market boats lined the water. Mom placed three coins in Bung's hand.
Ddori stretched an arm and called, "Ah! Ah!" Bung wanted to know what Ddori wanted.
The fingertip pointed toward something yellow. Bung thought anything yellow would do.
Yellow fruit piled high on another boat. Bung spent all three coins at once.
Bung returned with arms full of yellow bananas and mangoes. "Look, Ddori!" Ddori stretched to see past those arms.
No coins left. Bung's arms were full of yellow things, blocking Ddori's view.
Still Ddori reached and called, "Ah! Ah!" Bung did not understand.
Mom sat Bung right beside Ddori.
Sitting down changed the view. On the next boat, a yellow duckling waddled about.
Bung and Ddori sat side by side on that boat. Ddori gently stroked the duckling's back. Bung smiled beside Ddori.
